items.markdown:
You can calculate your customer attrition online using the [Yotpo Churn Rate Calculator](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator/) or the [Amplitude Churn Calculator](https://amplitude.com/calculate/churn-rate).[[1]](https://amplitude.com/calculate/churn-rate)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator/)

### The Churn Rate Formula

To find your churn rate manually, divide the number of customers lost during a specific period by the number of customers you had at the start of that same period, then multiply by 100.[[1]](https://amplitude.com/calculate/churn-rate)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator/)

Churn Rate=(Customers Lost Customers at Start of Period)×100 Churn Rate equals open paren the fraction with numerator Customers Lost and denominator Customers at Start of Period end-fraction close paren cross 100 C h u r n R a t e=C u s t o m e r s L o s t C u s t o m e r s a t S t a r t o f P e r i o d×1 0 0

### Example Calculation

- **Starting customers:** 1,000
- **Lost customers:** 50
- **Calculation:** (50 ÷ 1,000) × 100 = 5%
- **Monthly Churn Rate:** 5%[[1]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator/)[[2]](https://churntools.com/churn-rate-calculator)

### Key Metrics to Know

- **Customer Churn:** Measures the raw percentage of individual users or accounts that leave.
- **Revenue Churn:** Measures lost Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) instead of user counts. It uses the formula: (MRR Lost ÷ Starting MRR) × 100.
- **Customer Lifetime:** Calculated as 1 ÷ Churn Rate. A 5% monthly churn rate yields an average customer lifetime of 20 months.[[1]](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance/churn-rate)[[2]](https://www.yotpo.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator/)[[3]](https://observix.ai/free-tools/churn-rate-calculator)[[4]](https://churntools.com/churn-rate-calculator)[[5]](https://www.churnnote.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BNWKIGX9WFE&t=38)
